name: Screenplay
description: A screenplay: a title page and the script, with its scene headings, action, characters, dialogue, parentheticals and transitions on the standard page.

source.name: The standard screenplay page, as the screenplay layout has it
source.notes: The parts of a script are kinds of paragraph (ADR 0029); the page is the layout's. The title page carries the title and the writer's details, as the studios and competitions ask.
